title: Integrated ablation: warm supply, flow balancing, thermal-credit placement and grid deferral, 2^4 factorial
research_question: On one 128-GPU simulated facility with a demand-response cap, which of the next-generation components lower facility energy per on-time job, do they combine additively, and does the full combination keep service and thermal safety?
hypothesis: 16 nodes (4 racks x 4, 8 GPUs each, series pairs, branch resistance spread 1.0), load 0.75, ambient 30 C, NTU plant, 15:00-17:00 + 30 min drain, a 60 kW grid cap 16:00-16:30 enforced in every arm. Factors: S warmest-safe supply (3 K margin) vs fixed 25 C; V heat-proportional valves vs equal; T thermal_credit vs least_loaded; D defer deferrable jobs during the cap vs not. Paired by seed. H1: the full system (S1V1T1D1) has at least 5% lower energy per on-time job than the baseline (S0V0T0D0), 95% CI below 0. H2: removing any one component from the full system raises energy per on-time job (each leave-one-out arm vs full: mean > 0). H3: the full system's on-time fraction is within 1 percentage point of the baseline's (seed means). H4: the full system's chip-seconds above t_target are at most the baseline's (seed means). Descriptive: main effects and two-way interactions (effect coding, seed-mean energy per on-time job), cap compliance, cost and emissions.
null_hypothesis: No component or combination changes energy per on-time job, service or safety.
controlled_variables: same topology, plant, ambient and cap
evaluation_criteria: Paired relative differences with 95% t-CI; seed means for fractions; effects from seed means.
randomization: Job streams drawn per seed, shared by all arms.
measurement_boundary: Simulated facility grid power of 128 GPUs (IT / conversion, pumps, fans, chiller).
known_limitations: Excludes the Stage 3 MPC (single-node simulator) and Stage 8 supervision (separate E019); instant plant; illustrative signals; one ambient; hand-set component parameters.
disclosure: Before registration: E015 and E016 results; the designs (not results) of E018-E022; shortened dry-runs of the E018/E020/E022 pipelines in a scratch database (10-minute runs, not representative). No E024 cell was run before registration.
data_collection: Append-only store; time series for seed 0.
statistics: Paired by seed; d = (A - B)/B; mean with 95% t-CI.
